agentUpdateInstructions: Update from v0.4.4 to v0.4.5 without resetting. Stop writers and back up D1, R2, Durable Object state and private settings. Install frozen dependencies with Node 22.20.0, pnpm 10.12.4 and @runeditrun/rer 0.2.51. This release adds no migrations or product behavior. Use rer deploy with the pinned rer: it accepts applied migration subsets by name and recorded bytes, applies every missing migration in filename order, and verifies readback by name set and bytes. Unknown migration names, changed bytes and uncertain history remain refused. Do not delete or reorder ledger rows. Older installations may lack migrations that sort below applied rows; apply them through rer before the updated Worker starts. In particular, 124_contact_email_proof_guard.sql and 126_restore_contact_erasure.sql bracket the immutable 125 backfill and restore the identical native_integration_erasure trigger. The documented 125 contact email-proof and 129 owner-alert data changes remain intentional. Preserve owner credentials, support history, permissions, imports, file bytes and erasure fences. Keep uncertain external outcomes without replay and retain human Send.
publicReleaseNotes: HappyToHelp v0.4.5 contains the same product behavior as v0.4.4 and pins @runeditrun/rer 0.2.51. Hosted installations deployed from gated migration subsets can now apply missing migrations even when their names sort below already applied rows. Rer still refuses unknown names, changed bytes and uncertain history, and checks the final migration set and recorded bytes. There are no new migrations. Back up, retain private settings and deploy with the pinned rer without resetting. The existing test-runtime queue-consumer isolation from main 5f7c1f3 is included. Hosted and paid-provider quality remain separately qualified; accessibility remains on owner HOLD. Production deployment is separate.
